g.title: Per-modality front ends
g.text: out: patched context and per-patch mask
plus (loc, scale), kept for the inverse
each covariate channel becomes its own
token row on the batch axis (mask = 1)
run once offline and cached; tubelets fuse
frame pairs, so 8 frames -> 4 latent slices

g.title: Numeric tokenisation, unchanged from S1
g.text: shared by the target row and all 14 covariate rows
The numeric path is byte-identical to S1
Same backbone, same patch size 16, same schedule. S2d is initialised from the S1
checkpoint, so every difference in behaviour is attributable to the visual path.

g.title: Resampler-free visual path (VisualPatchProjector)
g.text: each 2x2 block is CONCATENATED, never averaged:
token-wise: nothing is mixed across cells
learned 49 x 768 table, added by cell index
spatial identity only -- no slice embedding
per cell, score = cosine dissimilarity to the same
cell one slice back; slice 0 pinned as the anchor.

g.title: Interleaved assembly inside the final context patch
g.text: 5. Interleaved assembly -- placement inside context patch 41 (parameter-free)
modality, segment and token-type tags come from the same tables the numeric tokens use, with the visual identifiers
inside context patch 41 (an 8 h span), before the first future token
fractional rotary index p = 41 + (1 - dt / span) x 0.99, so each slice sits by its age inside patch 41
49 of these 147 kept by global top-k
The visual tokens sit between the last context token at p = 41 and the first future position at p = 42, not appended after the sequence.
Interleaving is POSITIONAL, not by array order: the encoder is non-causal, so only the RoPE index locates a visual token in time.
out: target row [B, 141, 768] = 42 numeric + 98 visual + 1 future | 14 covariate rows padded to the same length

g.title: Chronos2Encoder
g.text: Chronos2Encoder -- x12 identical blocks (top 3 of 12 train at 0.1x the base learning rate, same policy in every arm)
this is where vision enters in S2d
over all 141 tokens. No modality mask,
no gate, no separate visual stream.
Visual tokens are ordinary rows: they need
no kernel change and no extra parameters.
acts on the BATCH axis: the target row
No visual row here -- unlike S2a, vision
is inside the time sequence, not a
sibling series on the batch axis.
no side channel of any kind.
last T_hor hidden states, target rows only: [B, 1, 768]
